title: Shifting the input by a prefix
statement: Let $R$ be the number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, and let $P$ assign an instruction to each label. For any bit strings $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{suffix}$ and any state $s$, taking one step on the concatenated input $\mathrm{pre} \mathbin{+7} \mathrm{suffix}$ from the state whose read position is increased by the length of $\mathrm{pre}$ gives the same state as first taking one step on $\mathrm{suffix}$ from $s$ and then increasing the resulting read position by the length of $\mathrm{pre}$.
hypotheses_covered: A counter program with $R$ registers and labels in $\Lambda$
